name: carrick
description: Shows what the other services in your workspace do with the routes and calls in the file you are editing

carrick.binary.description: Path to the carrick CLI. Empty means the carrick on PATH (npm install -g carrick).

carrick.diagnostics.description: Publish Carrick's verdicts in the Problems panel.

carrick.definition.description: Go to definition on a call site jumps to the handler in the other repo, and on a route lists the call sites that reach it. Off means Carrick answers nothing and your other definition providers are untouched.

carrick.boundary.description: Show what the scan could not classify, in the status bar. Your agent's own channel states it whatever this is set to.

carrick.codeLens.description: Show a lens above a route or call the index holds a counterpart or a mismatch for. Rows it knows nothing about get no lens.
